langs.intro: Which languages the office, the documents and the floor speak, how numbers and dates are written, and how time is kept.

office.title: Office languages
office.intro: Every office screen speaks both. Both are always on in this version.
office.pick: Each person picks their own language in

documents.title: Document and e-mail languages
documents.intro: Quotes, purchase orders, DDTs, invoices and their e-mails go out in Italiano or English: in the language on the customer's or supplier's record. Below, each company's own language.
documents.label: The language of each company

formats.title: Numbers and dates
formats.intro: Each person sees numbers and dates written the way of their own language.
formats.imports: A sheet you import may write numbers either way: you say which when you upload it.

time.title: Time zones
time.intro: How the factory keeps time, and the zone of each company and site.
time.label: Time zones of the companies and sites

floor.title: Floor languages
floor.intro: The languages the floor workers read, each in its own words. The floor screens speak Italiano and English; a worker who reads another language sees Italiano for now.

langs.later: A glossary of trade terms and a check of machine-translated messages come in later steps.

problem.conflict: Someone changed a company meanwhile ({count} saved before it). The page was read again: check and save once more.
